title: Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient Method for Multiobjective Optimization Problems of Interval-Valued Maps
summary: In this article, we propose an algorithm for the nonlinear conjugate gradient method to find a Pareto critical point of unconstrained multiobjective interval optimization problems. In this algorithm, we use the Wolfe line search procedure to find the step length. After defining the standard Wolfe conditions and the strong Wolfe conditions, we prove that there exists an interval of the step length that satisfies the standard Wolfe conditions and the strong Wolfe conditions.
